'''Dossa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. She was a long time assignment of [[Haazen]] during his time as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] on [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]]. After several of his failures to capture her, Dossa once again humiliated him by stealing his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from him and this time Haazen was only saved from death by the timely arrival of his friend [[Barrison Draay]].<ref name="KOTOR 33" />

Ten years later, Dossa eventually became a [[Sith tattoo|tattooed]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Minion|servant]] under [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], and fought in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. She met Haazen again after the [[Battle of Toprawa (Great Sith War)|Battle of Toprawa]]. Sensing his jealousy of Barrison, she concocted a trap that to Haazen was meant for the Jedi, but in actuality was meant for Haazen as well. She had Haazen lead Barrison into the Ansharii Caverns on the pretense that a Sith base was hidden there. She then detonated a bomb that resulted in the death of Barrison Draay and Haazen's ultimate fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="KOTOR 33" />

When Haazen awoke after the blast, he screamed in agony as he saw how disfigured he was. Dossa told him that he had been pulled from the rubble by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Uburluh]] and "fixed up good." However, Haazen wanted revenge for what she had done to him, and he killed her in his anger.<ref name="KOTOR 33" />

Millennia later, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] would remember learning about her when considering taking another Nautolan, [[Naat Lare]], as an apprentice.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
